These works consist of the detailed design metocean assessment (MA) at two Wind Farm Zones (WFZs). One of the WFZs is IJmuiden Ver and the second WFZ is to be determined. The assessment includes the construction of a metocean database, and a metocean assessment (consisting of a metocean desk study and a wind resource assessment) on design level. The starting date of the contract is scheduled for Q2 2022. In Q4 2022, a first non public delivery is expected based upon existing data sources. In Q2 2023, a second delivery should contain around 6 months of measurement data from the planned floating LiDAR campaign in the Ijmuiden Ver WFZ (IJV WFZ). A third and fourth delivery will contain 1 year and 2 years of measurement data respectively. The fifth and sixth delivery will contain a comparable series for a second to be determined WFZ.
